description: This is a PHP unit test class for the BasicUserRoleManager component in the OrangeHRM project. It contains various tests for methods like getAccessibleEntityIds, getAccessibleEntities, getUserRoles, getScreenPermissions, and others, validating role-based access control, entity accessibility, and permissions within the authorization framework.

classes.name: BasicUserRoleManagerTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the BasicUserRoleManager, including role-based access controls and entity permission methods.
